purpose: Machine-readable upper-bound projection for detecting paid-endpoint usage that cannot be explained by declared scheduled callers.

material_excess.rule: flag only when actual counter delta is known and exceeds projected upper bound by more than max(absolute_credits, fraction * projected_upper_bound)

scheduled_callers.paid_when: At least one MLB game falls inside the script's +/-8 minute T-180, T-90, or T0 capture window; outside those windows the run exits before calling The Odds API.

provider_credit_upper_bound_per_paid_run.derivation: One /sports/baseball_mlb/odds request for h2h, spreads, totals in one bookmaker/US region; provider cost is at most 3 usage credits when data is returned.

scheduled_callers.paid_when: Every scheduled AUTOMATIC run that reaches native Odds API acquisition with a usable key; failed key slots may add zero-credit HTTP attempts before a usable slot succeeds.

http_request_upper_bound_per_paid_run.derivation: Three free /events catalog calls + one featured-game /odds call + three per-event odds calls for each MLB game that binds to the current StatsAPI slate.

provider_credit_upper_bound_per_paid_run.derivation: Featured game markets cost <=3 credits. Per bound event: 33 player-prop market keys + 1 team-total key + 6 additional-market keys, one US region. The provider charges unique markets actually returned, so this is a conservative upper bound. /events catalog calls are quota-free.

manual_or_conditional_callers.accounting_rule: Any rescue dispatch must be represented by a GitHub workflow run and is added to the declared projection at digest time rather than silently treated as scheduled baseline.

fail_closed_rules: Cron drift between this artifact and the live workflow makes the projection UNKNOWN.
Missing provider cumulative counters makes actual usage UNKNOWN.
Counter reset/non-monotonicity makes actual usage UNKNOWN for that key slot.
UNKNOWN actual usage blocks an actual-vs-projected anomaly judgment; UNKNOWN never renders as zero.
Manual/rescue paid callers are not allowed to disappear into baseline; their workflow run IDs must be surfaced separately.
